newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin Express says to bid for Air Liberte.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Express says to bid for Air Liberte.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Express regional airline will bid for ailing French carrier Air Liberte, chief executive officer Jonathan Ornstein said on Wednesday.
"We will make an offer," Ornstein told Reuters.
Ornstein, who declined to give any details of the bid, said the offer would be made "soon".
Other bidders include Virgin rivals British Airways Plc (BA) through its French TAT unit, and a French/Moroccan group headed by travel group Nouvelles Frontieres chairman Jacques Maillot.

Monday was the deadline for bids for Air Liberte, which went into receivership on September 26, but Ornstein said one of his advisors had said an offer could be submitted up to 48 hours prior to the final decision.
"So we are pursuing this," he said.
